extDescription.message: Lets your yarnnn agent work in Chrome for you — in its own tabs, with your sign-ins, one site at a time.

consentBody.message: It will work in its own tab, in a group called yarnnn, which you can watch. It uses the sign-ins you already have on this site, and it can read the page, fill in fields and press buttons — including sending and posting when you ask it to.

consentLater.message: You can take this back any time from the yarnnn button in Chrome's toolbar.

none.message: None yet — you'll be asked the first time.

neverBody.message: Banking and payments, trading and crypto, password managers, and account security pages — whatever you allow.
